sections.label: Singapore UN vote two-state solution
sections.summary: Singapore and most UN member states voted for a resolution endorsing the New York Declaration supporting the two-state solution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Recently, Singapore and a large majority of the member states at the United Nations (UN) General Assembly voted in favour of a resolution endorsing the New York Declaration to support the two-state solution.

sections.label: Gaza deaths and homes destroyed

sentences.text: More than 60,000 people have been reportedly killed and a third of them children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: An estimated 90% of homes have been destroyed or damaged.

sections.label: Singapore aid to Gaza
sections.summary: Singapore will continue contributing to international efforts to alleviate civilian suffering in Gaza, having contributed 10 tranches of humanitarian aid.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Singapore will continue to do what we can to contribute to international efforts to alleviate civilian suffering in Gaza.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: So far, the Government and Singaporeans have contributed 10 tranches of humanitarian aid.

sections.label: Total Gaza humanitarian assistance

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: All these efforts will bring our total humanitarian assistance for Gaza to more than $24 million.

sections.label: Gaza peacekeeping and Palestine recognition
sections.summary: No formal UNSC proposal for a UN peacekeeping force in Gaza exists; Singapore will recognise Palestine when it meets stated conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: On the issue of peacekeeping, which Mr Saktiandi Supaat has asked about, whilst the idea of a UN stabilisation mission in Gaza is being discussed informally, there is currently no formal proposal for a UN peacekeeping force in Gaza at the UN Security Council (UNSC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In fact, we had changed our position in May last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will recognise the State of Palestine when it has an effective government that accepts Israel's right to exist and categorically renounces terrorism.

sections.label: Sanctions on settler leaders
sections.summary: Singapore will impose targeted sanctions on leaders of radical right-wing settler groups responsible for violence against Palestinians in the West Bank.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Consequently, Singapore will impose targeted sanctions on the leaders of radical right-wing settler groups or organisations that have been responsible for acts of violence against Palestinians in the West Bank.

sections.label: Reconsidering Palestinian state recognition
sections.summary: Singapore will reconsider its position on recognising a Palestinian state if the situation worsens or Israel further undermines a two-state solution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: If the situation continues to deteriorate or if Israel takes further steps to extinguish a two-state solution, we will reconsider our position on recognising a Palestinian state.

sections.label: Technical assistance to Palestinians
sections.summary: Singapore's S$10 million Enhanced Technical Assistance Package has already benefitted more than 800 Palestinian officials.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Our S$10 million Enhanced Technical Assistance Package has already benefitted more than 800 Palestinian officials.

sections.label: Discussions with Israeli and Palestinian counterparts
sections.summary: The speaker held candid discussions with Israeli and Palestinian counterparts and told Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar that denying humanitarian aid breaches international humanitarian law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: I recently had candid, open discussions with both my Israeli and Palestinian counterparts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: I made it clear to Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar that we see the deliberate and unlawful denial of humanitarian aid to civilians as a breach of international humanitarian law.

sections.label: Criticism of Israel's actions
sections.summary: Singapore called out Israel's airstrikes on Doha as violating Qatar's sovereignty and said denying aid and shooting people seeking food violates international humanitarian law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Earlier this month, we had to call out Israel's airstrikes on Doha as a blatant violation of Qatar's sovereignty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We have also said that the deliberate and unlawful denial of humanitarian aid to civilians and people reportedly being shot while desperately trying to access food, in our view, is a violation of international humanitarian law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Territorial and political compromise is essential if this conflict is ever to be resolved.

sections.label: Hopes for two-state negotiations
sections.summary: Singapore hopes both sides will find political will and leadership to negotiate a two-state solution consistent with UN Security Council resolutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: As a friend to the people on both sides, we only hope that in time, there will be political will, there will be inspired leadership on both sides to enter into direct negotiations on a two-state solution, consistent with the relevant UN Security Council (UNSC) resolutions.

sentences.text: I will allow Members to raise points of clarification on all three Statements after the end of the third Statement.
